text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
This could be my chance to make a
sneaky cameo
appearance. Slooowly
does it... Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Staff
text_block_list.text:
Oh! I'm so sorry! You'll be in the shot if
you stand
there. Could you please move
out of the frame?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...I was spotted. That member of staff
has a keen
eye.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
My cameo fell through and I looked
ridiculous...
